steps.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: SchoolSafe JASPE 2D sprite sheet, exact 1536x1024 PNG, strict 2 columns x 2 rows, each cell 768x512, zero borders/gutters/text. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
Input image 1 is the identity, uniform, rendering, desk geometry and light background reference. Derive a NEW matched animation sheet: JASPE rises from her chair BEHIND the same desk. This is a raster illustration for a 2D application, not a 3D model.
Keep the exact same little girl's identity: warm brown skin, large brown eyes, two curly puff buns with center braids, tiny stud earrings, navy pinafore, white short-sleeved collared shirt and navy striped tie. Same age, facial features and proportions. Keep desk, closed navy book on left, navy pencil cup on right, camera, scale and lighting fixed across all FOUR cells. Pale icy blue background #eaf4fc, opaque, no checkerboard.
Movement in four distinct neighboring phases:
1: seated, leaning slightly forward to prepare to rise, both palms planted naturally on desk, gentle closed-mouth smile.
2: pushing gently on both hands, shoulders starting to rise, torso uncoils.
3: halfway up, elbows almost straight, upper torso clearly more upright.
4: standing upright BEHIND the desk, upper body visible down to waist where the desk naturally occludes it, both hands resting lightly on desk, warm attentive expression.
Keep the wooden desk fixed in exactly the reference location at the bottom of each cell; the reference tabletop/apron, book and cup must not jump between cells. All hair, face, arms and hands must remain completely inside every cell, with breathing room above the hair even when standing. The standing pose must read as standing, not just sitting and shrugging. A small forward lean before rising makes room for the natural motion. Feet, legs and chair remain fully hidden by the desk. No cut body edge floating above the desk. No extra fingers, no extra limbs, no redesigned face, no bow, no new accessories, no labels. Preserve bright foreground skin and crisp soft illustrated volume. Closely registered frames suitable to play forward and backward.

Use case: identity-preserve. Correct the first input JASPE rising sprite sheet. Input 1 is the edit target; input 2 is the original identity/desk reference. Output one exact 1536x1024 PNG, same 2x2 grid with 768x512 cells, no borders/text.
Keep the four chronological actions from input1: seated hands on desk, pushes to rise, halfway standing, standing upright behind desk. Keep the entire desk, book, cup, lighting and pale blue backdrop unchanged and registered in all cells.
Critical correction: FIXED CHARACTER SCALE across the four frames. Her head/hair and facial features must have the SAME physical size in every cell, approximately 285 pixels wide across the puff buns in each 768-wide cell. Never shrink the head or zoom out to simulate standing. A warm recognizable JASPE matching input2, same two curly puffs/center braids, brown eyes, brown skin, white/navy uniform/tie, age and proportions. Move the head naturally upward when straightening the torso.
Keep ALL hair visible with at least 20 pixels clear margin above the highest curl inside EACH cell, including top-right and bottom-left. At the beginning she leans slightly forward and low (top of hair around y=55 within cell); at the final standing pose top of hair around y=20. Torso straightens modestly with full upper torso visible above the unchanged tabletop and waist hidden behind it. Both palms maintain contact with the tabletop, elbows flexed at start and straight at end. This is a subtle natural rise, not a camera zoom. Keep four smoothly adjacent keyframes. Preserve identity precisely. No extra limbs, no chair/legs/feet visible, no cut curls, no background alteration.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the finished JASPE rising sprite sheet, 1536x1024, 2x2 cells. Replace ONLY the pale blue background of all four cells with uniform deep navy #19334F. Preserve exactly all four successive rising poses, every facial feature, the size and placement of her head/hair/torso/hands, bright brown skin, navy and white school uniform/tie, pale wooden desk, navy book on the left, pencil cup on the right. Keep the foreground bright and unchanged. Preserve complete curls and smooth edges without pale halos. Keep the exact grid, camera, framing, and desk registration. Opaque PNG, no checkerboard, no transparency, no labels, no text.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the FINAL JASPE standing-and-speaking 2x2 sprite sheet. Change ONLY the four pale blue backgrounds to dark navy #19334F. Preserve the four standing gestures, her identity, face/head/hair scale and exact positions, mouth shapes, two visible hands, uniform, foreground lighting, fixed wooden desk, navy closed book left and pencil cup right. Skin and white shirt remain bright, not darkened. Exact 1536x1024 PNG, four equal 768x512 cells, no gutters, no borders, no text. Keep all curl edges without a pale halo. Opaque background, no transparency or checkerboard. No other change.
